panels.description: Highest minus lowest SOA serial served for each zone across the selected nodes. Non-zero for longer than a zone cache rebuild means a node serves an old copy (KudurruSerialDivergence).
panels.title: Serial divergence

panels.description: Nodes holding each VIP as VRRP MASTER (kudurru_vip_master from `kudurru vip run`). Exactly 1 is healthy; 0 means nobody answers on the VIP, 2 or more is a split brain.
panels.title: VIP masters

options.content: These panels come from the keepalived supervisor's metrics listener (:8085). With kube-vip or MetalLB, ownership is visible in the Service status and in those projects' own metrics.
